title: A modeling method, device, equipment and medium based on federated learning

pse.problem: Building an intelligent and effective quota approval model for customizing accurate quotas for customers in financial and banking applications, where data isolation between banks and regulatory requirements make it difficult to achieve data sharing and build a high-quality quota approval model.
pse.solution_function: The method combines the data of two participants (first and second) to establish a quota approval model using federated learning. It involves training models on user feature data, exchanging encrypted model parameters and intermediate results for iterative training, and updating models based on gradient information.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include user intersection determination, encrypted data exchange, and machine learning models (first model and second model).
pse.solution_implementation: The method first determines a user intersection between the first participant's first sample and the second participant's second sample. Then, it receives encrypted first model parameters and first intermediate results from the second participant. Subsequently, it trains the first model using the first data (first user feature data corresponding to the determined user intersection) to obtain model parameters and intermediate results. The gradient information is then used to train the second model with the first participant's second data (second user feature data and label data corresponding to the user intersection). This process continues iteratively until training is completed. Optional steps include data cleaning, abnormal value processing, and differential privacy techniques for determining user intersections.
pse.effect: Improved accuracy of the quota approval model by leveraging data from various banking institutions while maintaining customer privacy
